source_title: Ranbir reveals he could never look at THESE two people in the eye
source_excerpt: Ranbir Kapoor has often spoken about his complicated yet deeply influential relationship with his late father, Rishi Kapoor. While Ranbir grew up with a father who was often critical of his work, his childhood friend Abhishek Bachchan shared a different equation with his father, Amitabh Bachchan. During a recent appearance on 'Kaun Banega Crorepati 18', hosted by Amitabh, Ranbir opened up about the Kapoor family's approach to parenting, recalled some stories about his father and grandfather Raj Kapoor, and discussed how Amitabh handled Abhishek's career and personal life.Amitabh, who shared screen space with Rishi Kapoor in films such as 'Amar Akbar Anthony' and 'Kabhi Kabhie', asked Ranbir about the advice his father would give him regarding his film choices. So, my father used to ask me about âwhich nation I was serving? Are these films for Tier 1 or who?â At that time, I didnât realise what he was trying to say. As an actor, I was following an individualistic approach naturally. The crowd used to come, applaud, cheer, and give him money. When the act ended, the boy used to go to his father and ask, âHow was it?â Heâd always say, âThereâs room for improvementâ. This kept happening for years.âHe continued, âThen one day, years later, he asked his father, âI do so well and I get so much praise, then why do you say that?
